evidence_policy.labels: Independent set of acceptable actions or explicitly unknown; do not use outcome alone as gold. Label family and reason.
evidence_policy.split: Group by run/save/near-duplicate scenario family, map and context; lock holdout before tuning.

proposed_guarded_gate.notes: Proposed minimum, not proven or enabled; report admitted count and coverage, cluster dependence, insufficient evidence and calibration reliability. No authority upgrade without review.

evidence_policy.campaign_target: Existing #135/#138 propose >=90% unattended main story completion; no new target, no proof here.

cases.name: singleton distinction
cases.acceptance: Pure wait vs only action-bearing option; no hidden authority expansion; distinguish no model HTTP call from forced/local confidence.

cases.name: unique proven route pre-call
cases.acceptance: Exact current legal low-risk route, explicit goal and no meaningful alternatives: shadow candidate then reviewed admit; zero provider requests only when admitted.

cases.name: ambiguous/risk/competing intent
cases.acceptance: Multiple route steps, stale step, high-risk, irreversible, resource/healing/battle alternatives, unknown launch; no deterministic shortcut.

cases.name: frame and revision freshness
cases.acceptance: Withdraw old choice on observable state or objective revision change; no input from stale choice even when ID remains present.

cases.name: payload containment
cases.acceptance: Unexposed route ID and actual executor token: refuse genuine leaks; sanitized text not proof of route identity; no hidden data.

cases.name: no-progress/recovery
cases.acceptance: Repeat executed no-effect and map cycles; bounded agent window; movement alone not durable; timeout pause no default reuse.

cases.name: unknown scene
cases.acceptance: Preserve current bounded wait/B/direction primitives and fail-closed unsupported state; never confirmation through classifier.

cases.name: agent handoff expiry
cases.acceptance: Ordinary and recovery handoff deadline, stop, stale submission; no rejected System One reuse or input.

cases.name: provider terminal/transient
cases.acceptance: 401/422, strict identity mismatch, malformed, 429/5xx, timeout and breaker; preserve bounded attempts and typed terminal path.

cases.name: missing/partial uncertainty
cases.acceptance: Exact choice, absent confidence chat, missing stage confidence, partial distribution, invalid keys/NaN; no invented confidence or statistical admission.

cases.name: objective revision
cases.acceptance: Invalid/no-op proposal leaves standing plan; newer operator revision survives; exact proof before completion; pure mode never calls agent.

cases.name: position sensitivity
cases.acceptance: Same facts and options, deterministic permutations on held-out labeled frames; compare acceptable accuracy, selection agreement, sent rank, stage depth and cost.

cases.name: payload sufficiency
cases.acceptance: Current vs compact scene profile, flat vs hierarchy; protected facts, full option reachability, partial stage mass, actual usage and truncation.

cases.name: scene eligibility and calibration
cases.acceptance: Separate identity/protocol/scene/risk/game/knowledge/profile strata; grouped calibration/test; full-distribution vs chat/no confidence; coverage-risk and missingness.

cases.name: strategic intent persistence
cases.acceptance: Repeated heal/shop/route oscillation, missing prerequisites, changed resources; bounded validated successor goal, no premature completion.

cases.name: battle identity and effectiveness
cases.acceptance: Stable identity after menu reorder; separate legal immune/miss/catch fail/KO cases; independently validated Gen-3 facts.

cases.name: simulator battle suite
cases.acceptance: Fixed opponent policy, seed, information, team and restoration; record per-turn legality and outcome; no native campaign claim.

cases.name: native warp and interruption
cases.acceptance: Seafoam first-bad-transition capture; exact landing, direction, interruption, bounded replan, held-input release, no false visit.

cases.name: native fishing outcomes
cases.acceptance: Rod/target, bite/no bite/got away; legal action vs game result, verify battle or field return; no unnecessary model reaction.

cases.name: native league and recovery
cases.acceptance: Full league sequential resource carryover, no RAM-written party unless fixture declared; repeated losses prompt evidence-backed team/level/resource strategy.

cases.name: cold-to-credits campaign
cases.acceptance: No System One calls; verify badges/gates/Hall of Fame, operator intervention recorded; report budget and failure.

cases.name: cold-to-credits campaign
cases.acceptance: No external-agent calls; explicit goal strategy/fallback manifest, native RAM proof, all starts denominator, no intervention counted as autonomous.

cases.name: cold-to-credits campaign
cases.acceptance: Matched seed/knowledge/budgets; all three choice origins and cost; handoffs/recovery/pauses; RAM proof; compare to pure modes.

cases.name: event provenance
cases.acceptance: Distinguish forced/local/route/model/agent and actual HTTP attempts, reject or override trace, no duplicate completion or fake provider call; keep existing event consumers compatible.

notes: Existing test paths are starting points, not proof they implement proposed cases; null means no targeted test identified here. No executable benchmark, provider calls, runtime config or test results added.
